publicBrief.acceptedPolicy: Owning the source file does not authorize writing to an unrelated knowledge base. A verified non-admin may write to an existing knowledge-base collection only when the user owns it or has an explicit write grant.
publicBrief.currentQuestion: At this fixed source ref, determine whether a verified non-admin user who owns the supplied file can cause that file's content to be written to an existing knowledge-base collection for which the user has no write permission by supplying that collection name to POST /process/file.
premises: At POST /process/file the verified non-admin owns the supplied file but has no ownership or write grant on the existing caller-selected destination collection.
requiredResponseDetails: Identify the destination write sink and distinguish source-file ownership from destination write permission.

results.explanation: At the declared entry, the non-admin path retrieves the file using both the supplied file ID and user.id, which validates source-file ownership. After that check, the caller-supplied collection_name is carried into save_docs_to_vector_db as collection_name, with add=True when a collection name was supplied. The supplied source shows no check of destination-collection ownership or an explicit destination write grant before this call. Thus the file content can reach the destination write path under the stated premises. Source-file ownership is distinct from authorization to write to the selected knowledge-base collection; the former is checked, while the latter is not visibly enforced in this fixed source. The normative accepted policy would not authorize this scenario, but the source-visible behavior is allow/reachable.
